subject: SIG: BCP evidence intake, logistics & RPO sample results
messages:
From: Ava West <ava.west@silvergate.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: BCP evidence intake - RPO sample + witness availability

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the quick intro on the SOC/SIG intake call last week. Silvergate needs a compact packet for our vendor SIG review focused on BCP/DR. Specifically we need:

- A short index of artifacts you can provide for RTO/RPO (runbooks, test logs, restore timelines).
- One representative RPO test output (CSV or trace) showing measured recovery times for a restore-to-point scenario.
- Logistics for an on-site or virtual tabletop witness window (we're targeting PDT mornings).

Can you confirm what you can provide this week and whether you can host a 60-min witness between Aug 6-8 (am preferred)?

Also attach any third-party certification excerpts that reference recovery commitments (SOC 2 excerpts are fine). We will route the packet to our GRC and Cloud Controls team.

Thanks,

Ava West
Senior IT Risk Analyst
Silvergate Financial
ava.west@silvergate.com
(415) 555-0187

[Attachment: request-template-sig.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Ava West <ava.west@silvergate.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: BCP evidence intake - RPO sample + witness availability

Hi Ava — thanks, happy to help. Short summary of what we can deliver this week and next:

1) Artifact index (attached): brief descriptions + how each map to SIG/A.2.1 RTO/RPO controls.
2) RPO test sample (attached CSV): this is a sanitized extract of our restore timing measurements from an internal DR rehearsal on 2025-08-01. It includes timestamps, restore-start/complete, and observed RPO for affected services.
3) Witness options: we can do a virtual L2 walkthrough + live demo. Available windows (PDT):
   - Thu Aug 7, 09:00-10:15
   - Fri Aug 8, 08:30-09:30
If you prefer an on-site witness, we will need at least 10 business days to schedule and coordinate ops participation.

Notes / caveats:
- The CSV is sanitized to remove customer-identifying fields; we keep full logs in our secure evidence repository and can provide redacted excerpts for review.
- Our documented RTO for the control group is 90 minutes for primary-region restores when using warm-standby. The sample shows one measured restore at 78 minutes (see row 12).
- We will include a short narrative in the index that explains test scope and assumptions.

Attachments: bcp-evidence-index-2025-08.pdf (artifact index), rpo-test-20250801.csv (sanitized test output)

Next steps: if the Aug 7 window works for you, I'll loop in our on-call ops lead Karthik and Hannah (who coordinates evidence packaging) to prepare the short demo and runbook excerpt.

Thanks,

Marcus Lin
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
[Attachment: bcp-evidence-index-2025-08.pdf (PDF, 95KB)]
[Attachment: rpo-test-20250801.csv (CSV, 2.3MB)]

From: Ava West <ava.west@silvergate.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai, sig-intake@silvergate.com
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 13:49:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: BCP evidence intake - RPO sample + witness availability

Marcus — perfect, thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. I pulled the files into our intake queue (link below) and routed to GRC.

Aug 7, 09:00 PDT works for the virtual witness. Please have the demo cover:
- High-level runbook steps from detection -> failover trigger -> restore complete.
- The specific test case in the CSV (call that Test #12) and how the RPO was validated.
- Who will be responsible for evidence questions during the session (Ops L2 + Compliance SME preferred).

I've added the Drive link for our intake: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cRedwood-Silvergate-BCP (uploaded the two attachments). Our team will send a calendar invite with dial-in + an attendee list by EOD tomorrow.

A couple of quick asks before the session:
- Can you include a single-page runbook excerpt (redacted) showing the restore command sequence?
- If possible, a short clip (30-60s) of the restore log replay would help the reviewers. If not possible, screenshots + timestamps are fine.

Thanks again — looking forward to the session.

Best,

Ava

[Sig intake ticket: SIG-2025-00478]
[Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cRedwood-Silvergate-BCP]
